reviews.text: A person like you'd love to meet. Kind and, above all, attentive to the animal. My dog ​​looks gorgeous with her little bow tie.

I took my two Shiba Inu girls to Paula and I'm thrilled with the results! 🥰

One of my dogs is very timid and sensitive, but she immediately felt at ease thanks to Paula's kindness, gentleness, and patience ❤️

My two girls came out looking absolutely gorgeous, with beautiful coats, they smelled wonderful, and most importantly, they were perfectly calm afterward 🐶🌸

A huge thank you to Paula for her work and her incredibly gentle approach. I highly recommend her! ✨

I 100% recommend Naturally Dog! I took my Shiba Inu there and he came out looking absolutely gorgeous! Plus, Paula offered my partner and me the chance to stay with Ucco (which is rare). She's incredibly kind and gentle! My dog ​​was truly pampered! Bonus: she has a loyalty card where you get an extra 20% off already very reasonable prices, and for his first grooming session, Ucco came out sporting a very stylish bow tie! Thank you, Paula, for Ucco! 😍 Can't wait to go back!

A groomer who truly loves animals and puts them at ease. My dog ​​was as excited about her as he was about us at the end, which never happens because he's very timid. Great haircut. I highly recommend her.

Incredibly kind and professional. I've taken my Rottweiler there several times, including yesterday, and each time everything is done with care, precision, and great attention. A huge thank you for your work and kindness; I highly recommend them!
We've been coming for a few months now and each time we're delighted with the welcome and care our dog receives. We highly recommend it!
I just gave my Pattou a thorough wash, he looks great, honestly so happy, great job!

I highly recommend this person for your four-legged friend. Very professional and, above all, with a love for animals. Very gentle. I was very satisfied and will definitely return for my dog's well-being. 🐕 …

I thought the good reviews were just wishful thinking!

Well, no! Paula is truly very competent, even with a Cotton de Tulear 😘… full of knots… a dog who lives in the countryside!
I highly recommend her!

Top-notch groomer! My dog ​​is very fearful of strangers, but she was able to reassure him with incredible gentleness and patience. He was surprisingly calm throughout the entire grooming session. I also really appreciated that she gave me the option of staying during the appointment. Very kind, professional, and attentive to the well-being of animals. I highly recommend her!
